decision: Preserve the approved dirty M0 and structured-target worktree as the implementation baseline; make additive, boundary-scoped changes only.
reason: The approved design explicitly treats the current uncommitted implementation as required baseline state.

decision: Keep the zero-dependency deterministic core and expose optional network/PDF capabilities through injected or local adapters.
reason: M2 acceptance must remain offline and CI-gateable without paid services or credentials.

decision: Use the existing connector, quality, synthesis, loop, and artifact contracts as integration boundaries instead of creating domain-specific runtimes.
reason: This preserves M0 validity, target-intelligence compatibility, and one common evidence contract.

decision: CLI defaults to anonymous AnySearch while programmatic ResearchEngine.run retains an explicit none default.
reason: This enables unseeded CLI research while preserving backward-compatible and privacy-safe library behavior.

decision: An explicit non-generic research_scope profile overrides auto-selected generic pack templates; matching explicit packs retain legacy normalized templates.
reason: Otherwise generic legacy templates suppress required technical, market, and job facets.

decision: Accept M1 after deterministic and live gates.
reason: 207 tests, Ruff, diff check, M0 9/9 and 5/5 invalid probes, AnySearch contract, generic smoke, and per-project technical/GitHub smoke passed.

decision: Treat stale rows as observable but claim-ineligible whenever a facet freshness window applies.
reason: Current claims must not be grounded by stale-only evidence; historical rows remain auditable.

decision: Execute at most one pass-2 repair and retain all pass-1 execution records and progress fingerprints.
reason: The approved loop permits bounded recovery without open-ended search or relaxed gates.

decision: Keep aggregate job-market snapshots separate from the stricter single-target contract and require explicit quantitative scope.
reason: Point-in-time counts need a company/role/level/geography denominator and cannot infer trend from one snapshot.

decision: Accept the offline B1-B10 suite only when the nested M0 score remains 9/9 with 5/5 invalid probes.
reason: M2 capability must not weaken the original evidence-validity gate.

decision: Reject the first independent review and remediate all six P1 and two P2 findings at their shared runtime boundaries.
reason: The first B1-B10 harness was partly self-fulfilling and multiple truthfulness boundaries did not yet constrain final claims or coverage.

decision: Treat an all-endpoint ATS transport failure as failed company coverage and reuse the authoritative singleton job-scope validator in snapshot aggregation.
reason: An upstream outage must not appear as a checked zero-opening observation, and direct APIs must not bypass planning validation.

decision: Aggregate job company coverage across all passes, with any successful retrieval winning and failed reserved for all-attempt failure.
reason: Per-request accumulation could place one company in both checked and failed after a successful repair.

decision: Accept M1 and M2 after the fourth independent review found no remaining P0-P2 findings.
reason: 257 tests, Ruff, diff check, B1-B10 10/10, M0 9/9, and 5/5 invalid probes all pass after root-cause remediation.
